stories.headline: NVIDIA *PROBES* HUANG'S RELATIONSHIP
stories.facts: Nvidia plans to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a possible spy after Huang allegedly admitted to having an affair in a company memo.
stories.caption_line: 🔍 Nvidia plans to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a possible spy following an internal memo acknowledging an affair.
stories.image_prompt: A confident cinematic portrait of Jensen Huang in the foreground with his trademark black leather jacket, looking off-camera against a dramatic tech backdrop. In the midground, a glass corporate boardroom overlooking a glowing city skyline at night with dark server towers. Floating holographic wireframes of AI microchips and glowing legal document panels hover in an electric-blue and warm-orange palette with sleek rim lighting.
stories.source_title: Nvidia will investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with possible Chinese spy

stories.headline: RIGHTS HOLDERS *SUE* SUNO
stories.facts: Rights holders for Elvis Presley and Eminem's music publisher sued Suno, alleging the AI platform illegally generates music and lyrics mimicking the artists.
stories.caption_line: ⚖️ Rights holders for Elvis Presley and Eminem's publisher filed lawsuits accusing AI music company Suno of unauthorized imitation.
stories.image_prompt: A vintage studio condenser microphone glowing on a stand in the foreground of a modern recording studio. In the midground, mixing consoles with glowing faders and vinyl records spinning on turntables. Holographic sound waves, glowing music staves, and translucent courtroom scale graphics float across the frame, lit with electric-blue studio neon and deep warm-orange amber rim lights.
stories.source_title: Elvis and Eminem rights holders are suing Suno

stories.headline: CODING AGENTS *FAIL* BENCHMARK
stories.facts: Alibaba revealed top model GPT-6 Astra solved only 26.4 percent of real tasks on its new coding benchmark.
stories.caption_line: 💻 Alibaba's new coding benchmark revealed top AI models fail nearly three-quarters of real-world tasks.
stories.image_prompt: A transparent glass computer terminal displaying glowing syntax errors and debugging panels in the foreground. In the midground, rows of dense server racks in an enterprise data center with blinking amber warning indicators. Floating holographic downward charts, red error symbols, and luminous data stream overlays surround the hardware, bathed in electric-blue and warm-orange neon lighting.
stories.source_title: AI coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three out of four tasks in a real-world test

stories.headline: APPLE SPEEDS UP *AGENTIC SIRI*
stories.facts: Apple leadership pressured AI chief Craig Federighi to accelerate development of an autonomous Siri to challenge rival agents.
stories.caption_line: ⚡ Apple executive leadership is pressing for faster development of autonomous Siri agent capabilities.
stories.image_prompt: A charismatic portrait of Craig Federighi in the foreground standing with arms crossed against a sleek presentation stage. In the midground, illuminated flagship smartphones stand upright displaying luminous orb animations on their screens. Floating holographic node graphs, rapid process flowcharts, and glowing assistant interface rings pulse around the space in vivid electric-blue and warm-orange gradient tones.
stories.source_title: Apple is racing to make Siri more agentic

stories.headline: KARPATHY BUILDS *AI VIDEO FEED*
stories.facts: OpenAI co-founder Andrej Karpathy used Claude Opus 5.5 to curate 6,454 videos from 43 million comments.
stories.caption_line: 🎥 Andrej Karpathy built an AI-curated video platform filtering 43 million forum comments in one weekend.
stories.image_prompt: A thoughtful portrait of Andrej Karpathy in the foreground, gazing outward against an ambient developer workspace. In the midground, multiple curved ultra-wide monitors showcase cascading video preview tiles and complex data pipelines. Floating holographic timeline streams, glowing sorting algorithms, and comment cluster visualizations emit radiant electric-blue and sunset warm-orange hues in moody cinematic lighting.
stories.source_title: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News

stories.headline: RESEARCHERS SAY *AI LACKS CONSCIOUSNESS*
stories.facts: Consciousness researchers argued in a Nature commentary that silicon-based AI cannot become conscious and warned against granting rights to AI systems.
stories.caption_line: 🧠 Consciousness researchers argued in Nature that silicon AI cannot achieve consciousness, advising against granting machines rights.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing holographic human neural network brain model suspended in the foreground of a high-tech neuroscience laboratory. In the midground, optical microscopes, crystalline silicon microchip wafers, and volumetric displays surround the central organ. Dynamic data rings, translucent cognitive wave graphs, and philosophical symbols glow vibrantly in an electric-blue and warm-orange color scheme with cinematic depth.
stories.source_title: The brain-as-computer metaphor shaped modern AI but may be misleading the consciousness debate

stories.headline: PIONEER REJECTS *SCALING HYPOTHESIS*
stories.facts: Turing Award winner Richard Sutton warned that scaling raw compute cannot achieve intelligence without entirely new learning algorithms.
stories.caption_line: 🛑 Turing Award winner Richard Sutton warns that brute-force compute scaling alone cannot yield true intelligence.
stories.image_prompt: A dignified portrait of computer science pioneer Richard Sutton in the foreground, looking forward thoughtfully. In the midground, a towering cluster of supercomputing mainframe cabinets with intricate cooling tubes and hardware arrays. Floating holographic plateau charts, mathematical equations, and fading algorithmic scaling curves glow in rich electric-blue and warm-orange tones with dramatic studio rim illumination.
stories.source_title: The inventor of the bitter lesson has a bitter lesson for LLM scaling enthusiasts

cover_subline: Plus music icons sue Suno, Apple rushes Siri, and coding models fail.
cover_image_prompt: An epic cinematic collage featuring a confident portrait of Jensen Huang beside an illuminated smartphone displaying an AI agent and a glowing microchip. caption:
Nvidia launches a major internal investigation as big AI moves sweep across the tech world.

1. 🔍 Nvidia plans to investigate CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a possible spy following an internal memo acknowledging an affair.
2. ⚖️ Rights holders for Elvis Presley and Eminem's publisher filed lawsuits accusing AI music company Suno of unauthorized imitation.
3. 💻 Alibaba's new coding benchmark revealed top AI models fail nearly three-quarters of real-world tasks.
4. ⚡ Apple executive leadership is pressing for faster development of autonomous Siri agent capabilities.
5. 🎥 Andrej Karpathy built an AI-curated video platform filtering 43 million forum comments in one weekend.
6. 🧠 Consciousness researchers argued in Nature that silicon AI cannot achieve consciousness, advising against granting machines rights.
7. 🛑 Turing Award winner Richard Sutton warns that brute-force compute scaling alone cannot yield true intelligence.
